nodes.title: The only judge deployment inside the 800 ms budget (lab-gpt41mini-in, capacity 50) allows 50 requests a minute, so as configured it can judge at most 50 caller turns a minute across all calls; above that the judge returns 429 and the floor's verdict stands (silently less recall). Inference for production load; measured only as the eval's 429s.
nodes.mitigation: Before raise mode or real traffic: size the judge deployment's capacity to peak caller turns per minute (or a pool of regional deployments), and alert on judge_unavailable reasons.

nodes.broke: 3/6 calls (2 v2-flashlite, 1 v2-mai) opened 'मैं Saanjh Services की AI असिस्टेंट हूँ।' before the greeting and then repeated the disclosure in her own words in the same breath ('नमस्ते आशा जी, मैं रिया हूँ, सांझ सर्विसेज से... आपकी AI असिस्टेंट'), because her first sentence ended at '!', '?' or '...' before her own disclosure. call_safety_event shows RD1 'replaced' at seq 2 in exactly those calls. Rate beyond these calls not measured (n=6); fix options (judge the first reply before prefixing, or a brief that puts the disclosure in the first sentence) are the voice owner's choice.
